caption: The drawing depicts a wooden object with a symmetrical, scalloped square shape, featuring a central square panel and four outwardly curved sides. The wood is shaded in brown tones, with visible grain and texture. The central panel shows an abstract floral motif outlined in black with details in beige. Each of the four sides contains embroidered designs, including flowers and leaf-like shapes, rendered in muted green, light blue, red, purple, pink, white, and beige thread. The top and bottom sections each display two flowers with small blue petals and circular centers. The left and right panels feature groups of colorful, overlapping leaf forms with horizontal lines suggesting stitching. The border of the object is outlined with a subtle, thin dark line. Beneath the object, the name "John Cooke—1938" is handwritten in pencil on the plain, off-white background.
title: Pin Tray
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
